Storybook, screen-reader behavior, real 200% browser zoom and final overlay provider ownership.

interactionContracts.selectionSync: One selectedObjectId drives ProjectTree, MapCanvas and ObjectInspector. Selection origin retains focus; visual selection is mirrored without moving focus.
interactionContracts.dirtyState: A committed field change sets dirty=true. SaveIndicator must not show saved while dirty or pending.
interactionContracts.save: UI may show saving immediately, but saved is only rendered after confirmed acknowledgement. Backend request shape is intentionally unspecified.
interactionContracts.overlays: Modal and modal Drawer make background inert, trap Tab/Shift+Tab, close on Escape when dismissal is safe and return focus to the opener.
interactionContracts.liveRegions: Routine loading/selection/save uses one polite region; conflict/offline/blocking error uses one assertive announcement per transition. Visible Alert text is not repeatedly mirrored by multiple live regions.
interactionContracts.treeKeyboard: Roving tabindex; Up/Down visible nodes, Right expand/child, Left collapse/parent, Home/End, typeahead, Enter activate, Space select when selection is separate.
interactionContracts.mapKeyboard: Toolbar uses roving focus with Left/Right/Home/End. Marker buttons use a separate roving group; Enter selects/opens, Escape returns to toolbar/context only when a transient map mode is active.
interactionContracts.reducedMotion: Disable smooth scrolling, spinner rotation and drawer/modal transitions; preserve immediate state changes and static loading text.

density.compact: 40px controls/rows; body text >=14px; metadata >=12px; intended for pointer-dense desktop only.
density.default: 44px controls/rows; required baseline for GIS and touch-capable layouts.
density.comfortable: 52px controls/rows; more spacing without hiding data or changing information hierarchy.
